budget_of:
def budget_of (bs : List (String × Int)) (c : String) : Int :=
  match bs with
  | [] => 0
  | (c0, v0) :: ps => if c0 = c then v0 else budget_of ps c
budget_set:
def budget_set (bs : List (String × Int)) (c : String) (a : Int) : List (String × Int) :=
  match bs with
  | [] => [(c, a)]
  | (c0, v0) :: ps => if c0 = c then (c, a) :: ps else (c0, v0) :: budget_set ps c a
by_category:
def by_category (s : State) : List (String × Int) :=
  s.expenses.foldl (fun acc (e : Expense) => cat_add acc e.category e.cents) []
cat_add:
def cat_add (acc : List (String × Int)) (cat : String) (a : Int) : List (String × Int) :=
  match acc with
  | [] => [(cat, a)]
  | (c0, v0) :: ps => if c0 = cat then (c0, v0 + a) :: ps else (c0, v0) :: cat_add ps cat a
cat_spend:
def cat_spend (l : List (String × Int)) (c : String) : Int :=
  match l with
  | [] => 0
  | (c0, v0) :: ps => if c0 = c then v0 else cat_spend ps c
insert_sorted:
def insert_sorted (x : String) (l : List String) : List String :=
  match l with
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insert_sorted x ys
sort_names:
def sort_names : List String → List String
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insert_sorted x (sort_names xs)
